Fail-safe.subject: Applied Sciences
Fail-safe.question: The _____ was Design feature or practice.
Fail-safe.fact: In engineering, a fail-safe is a design feature or practice that, in the event of a failure of the design feature, inherently responds in a way that will cause minimal or no harm to other equipment, to the environment or to people.
